note: T3 Code brand reference for the loft (identify only, never mock). Source: t3code repo commit 132be33 (2026-11-05), read-only. Hex values for oklch tokens converted with the standard OKLab matrix.

logo.description: White 'T3' glyphs on a black rounded square (128 px, radius 10). markOnly is the white T3 glyphs alone, for dark grounds.

look: Monochrome: black and white surfaces, zinc greys, thin 1 px white/8% borders, generous rounding (squircle app tiles), one electric-blue accent (#346BF1 on dark, #1B4ED8 on light) used sparingly for links, status and focus. Marketing site: black ground with a faint 1 px grid and soft indigo glow, white geometric sans headline. For a bright daylight loft: white/zinc-25 walls, zinc-200 trim, black accents (door frames, the logo plaque), one blue accent per room.
